act.name: Mediation Act, 2023
act.source_authority: Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing pre-litigation, court-referred, online and community mediation and enforcement of mediated settlement agreements.

sections.title: Pre-litigation mediation.
sections.text: Section 5 concerns voluntary pre-litigation mediation under the Mediation Act, 2023; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Parties may try mediation before filing civil or commercial proceedings, subject to the Act.
